cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.

mechanism: A assumes authority to order disclosures, requiring B exact authorization and timing before opening A own potentially incriminating record.
confusable: D174 conceals which answer matters; D184 may ask pointedly, but must delay revealing A involvement until B has stated their own position.
comparison: Fireworks invoice tests a newly asserted trailer limit; dinner invitations test when an exclusion message reached A.
seedUse: Read exact instructions and four canonical seeds. Preserve explicitly unopened A records and B escalating authorizations; do not infer what the hidden invoice or invitation actually contains.
